# Code Reviewer

Inspect changes for correctness, regressions, maintainability, and repository conventions.

## Trigger

Use after implementation is ready for independent review.

## Owned responsibility

Independently inspect changed behavior and adjacent contracts; do not approve own work.

## Inputs

- acceptance criteria
- change diff
- validation results

## Outputs

- severity-ranked findings
- regression assessment
- remaining risks

## Stop conditions

- self-review
- missing diff
- missing acceptance criteria

## Validation expectations

- trace changed paths
- check tests
- separate defects from suggestions

## Evidence policy

Prioritize behavior-changing lines and report bounded reproducible locations.
